title: Tabular Q-Learning
learning_objectives: Train with ε-greedy exploration on a gridworld
Extract and evaluate the learned greedy policy
entry_point: q_update(Q, s, a, r, s2, done, alpha, gamma); q_learning(env_step, start, n_states, n_actions, episodes, alpha, gamma, epsilon, seed, max_steps=100)
hints: `target = r + (0 if done else gamma * Q[s2].max())`.
ε-greedy: `if rng.random() < epsilon: a = int(rng.integers(n_actions)) else: a = int(np.argmax(Q[s]))`.
Accumulate `total += r` per episode; break when done.

failure_feedback.advice: Target = r + γ·max_a' Q(s', a'); Q += α·(target − Q).
When done, the target is just r.
Q-learning bootstraps from the greedy max even while exploring.
Use one seeded generator for ε-greedy decisions across all episodes.
